# Pegasus Capital Network

> An open professional networking and business discovery platform connecting lenders, investors, developers, builders, brokers, founders, AI companies, businesses and specialist partners. Create a free profile, showcase your work, discover companies and build relevant professional relationships.

Pegasus Capital Network supports public professional profiles, claimable company pages, business directories, opportunity and project presentations, networking, capital discovery, AI company research and partner introductions. Borrowers and brokers can describe financing scenarios and compare potential lenders based on published information. Participation is free to start. The platform is operated by Pegasus Lenders Group LLC; regulated financing, legal and securities matters remain with appropriately authorized providers.

- For: lenders, investors, borrowers, brokers, real estate agents, developers, builders, founders, AI businesses, attorneys, CPAs, and professional service providers
- Not a lender; Pegasus connects parties and charges no referral or success fees
- Nothing here is a commitment to lend or an offer or solicitation of securities

## Start here
- [Join Pegasus — free professional profile](https://pegasuscapitalnetwork.com/signup.html): Create a profile and participate in the network.
- [Business directory](https://pegasuscapitalnetwork.com/businesses): Explore public business pages and company specialties.
- [How it works](https://pegasuscapitalnetwork.com/how-it-works): How matching and the network operate.
- [Get financing](https://pegasuscapitalnetwork.com/get-financing): Post a scenario as a borrower.
- [Find a lender](https://pegasuscapitalnetwork.com/find-a-lender): Search lenders by appetite.
- [Match engine](https://pegasuscapitalnetwork.com/match-engine): How scenarios are matched to lender appetite.
- [Membership](https://pegasuscapitalnetwork.com/membership): Joining the network.

- [For borrowers](https://pegasuscapitalnetwork.com/borrowers): Get matched to fitting lenders.
- [For mortgage brokers](https://pegasuscapitalnetwork.com/find-a-lender): Place loans and keep your client.

- [Loan programs hub](https://pegasuscapitalnetwork.com/loans): Guides by loan type and state.
